title: Fleet device management (REST API, read-only API-only user)
readScopes: A Fleet API-only user with the global Observer role (read-only; Fleet Free), created with `fleetctl user create --name 'Sagentix collector' --api-only --global-role observer`; its API token is FLEET_API_TOKEN. The collector calls GET /api/v1/fleet/hosts only.

checks.title: Each host reports its disk as encrypted (FileVault, BitLocker or LUKS)
checks.scope: Every host enrolled in Fleet, one result per host, from Fleet's disk_encryption_enabled field; a host whose status Fleet does not know is skipped.

checks.title: Each host passes the Fleet policy that checks its screen lock
checks.scope: Hosts on which a screen-lock policy runs; what the policy's osquery SQL tests is the customer's, so the idle time it enforces is not judged here.

checks.title: Each host passes the Fleet OS-currency policy, or runs an OS at or above the given version floor
checks.scope: Hosts with an OS-currency policy or a --fleet-min-os floor for their platform; vendor support dates are not looked up.

checks.title: Each host passes the Fleet policy that checks its host firewall
checks.scope: Hosts on which a firewall policy runs; firewall rules themselves are not read.

checks.title: Each host passes the Fleet policy that checks for an EDR or antivirus agent
checks.scope: Hosts on which an EDR or antivirus policy runs; whether the agent's signatures are current or its alerts are reviewed is not judged.

checks.title: Each host is enrolled in an MDM
checks.scope: Hosts for which Fleet reports an MDM enrollment status (any MDM it detects); Linux and ChromeOS hosts have none and are skipped.

checks.title: Each host has checked in to Fleet within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every host enrolled in Fleet; the window is --fleet-seen-days. Devices never enrolled in Fleet are not seen at all.
